text.tspan: Three ways to talk to AWS, and which credentials each one uses
Access key ID (AKIA…) + Secret access key
uses your console login, NO keys needed
CLI v2 pre-installed, 1 GB $HOME per region
Access keys = a password for the CLI. The secret is shown ONCE at creation; max 2 keys per user (so you can rotate).
Never share them, never commit them to Git, never put them on EC2 (use a role). If leaked: deactivate → create new → delete old.
CloudShell and EC2 roles give TEMPORARY credentials instead (key IDs start with ASIA, plus a session token).
